steps.note: S2.3.1.1 traces rows 0-7 with initial scratch a,c and states the net target change (JV+RG)x is independent of a and c, matching the paper.
S2.3.1.2 gives the bit central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one pairs, and self coefficient one.
S2.3.1.3 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 with the side cancelling intersections zero and two, and self coefficient one.
S2.3.1.4 states the forward/inverse/forward stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), each invocation restoring its scratch wires.

The plan names only a few residuals (side 2->5, central P tensor F) and says the split A=B perp P, F=<t> perp t^perp 'gives every other residual' (S2.3.3.1.8), but never lists the per-edge orthogonal residuals and their dimensions of the paper's table.
S2.3.3.1.7 states t_X perp t_Y gives <t_X> subset t_Y^perp with complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2 on the side edge 2->5.
The plan confines decreases to center 3->4 losing h, telescopes to sources N and sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N, and adds 2L for the absolute sum Wm-2N+2L.

S2.3.3.3 states over F_2 every nonzero residual is nondegenerate and contains a norm-one coordinate unit, hence nonalternating with an orthonormal basis; the plane-absorption argument itself is not spelled out but the defining claim and its reason are.
S2.3.3.4 gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 via L/N=3ch/v with the paper's parameters.
S2.3.5.1 gives the weight identity, additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, and q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal residual basis, negated on decreasing edges.
S2.3.5.2 states wt(v) odd, the phase i^{eps[v.x]} decomposition, and H diag(1,-1) H = X giving aI+bX_v or its inverse.
S2.3.5.4 states that on k columns each residual vector contributes one tensored factor, with s_c factors in all (quoted).

The plan gives zero label frame I, full label C^{tensor m}, C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) repaired by Z_{a,k} before and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after via C=iZC^{-1}Z, and negation of the X outputs.
The plan states both loss ratios are below 1/2 and derives the positive deficits N-2L_b (bit) and 2N-2L_c (complex), giving s<Wm.
S2.3.6 states both deficits exceed 20*2^{-50}, log m<20, m^{1-2^{-50}} > m(1-eta), hence s/W < m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}.
The plan pivots at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, clears left and below by lower-triangular elementary operations, repeats on the remaining indices, and concludes Pi has exactly a ones.
S2.4.1.1 fixes the factorizations once and picks a fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators, so the shear is over Z/q^b with the triangular factors usable there.
S2.4.1.1.2 states a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order from earlier unchanged coordinates.
S2.4.1.1.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j yielding (h+d,d) with one interchange, a in all.
The plan gives E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu as the least j with m^j>=B, C_0=128m(s+E)^2, Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) and C_1=20, though it omits the rule C_1=max{20,nu+3} and the value nu=11.
The plan states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at internal nodes and A(e)<=8e at leaves, with one invocation adding fewer than E operations (at most 12W gates of at most 2W^2 operations plus corrections).

S2.5.5.1 asserts A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} 'through ceil(log_m d) levels' but omits the unrolling inequality B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu (from B<=m^nu) and the piece and outer-phase accounting that keeps the total below C_0 d^{C_1}, so it asserts the result without the sub-step.
The plan states depth-t values lie in 2^{-(p+t)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^t, that p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits are exact, and that eps C_1<1 gives Delta=o(p).
S2.5.7 states every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved, and the single final truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^{-p}.

summary: P05 is a detailed plan that tracks the paper's derivations closely; 24 of 26 sub-steps are present and none wrong. Absent: L1 (the per-edge residual table is replaced by a one-line 'splitting gives every other residual') and S3 (the depth bound 8B^2 d^{nu+1} is asserted without the unrolling inequality B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu or the accounting below C_0 d^{C_1}).
